name: Automated Track Geometry Inspection Run and Exception Triage
l2: Automated Track Inspection (geometry and rail flaw)
description: A track geometry car traverses the subdivision on a scheduled cycle, recording gauge, cross-level, alignment and surface measurements against Federal Track Safety Standards class limits. Exceptions are scored and routed to the Roadmaster for disposition. Union Pacific reports track-caused defects down approximately 85% over the roughly five years since it began its automated track inspection program. Priority defects generate an immediate slow order; the Track Supervisor confirms the restriction is in force before the next train is authorised over the segment, and the resulting change is carried into the subdivision track data file so that onboard enforcement matches the condition of the railroad.
inputs: Prior exception history for the subdivision
outputs: Slow order request for priority defects
pain_points: Exception volume exceeds gang capacity during peak surfacing season
